title: mirabilis californica var. glutinosa
intro: Mirabilis californica var. glutinosa, commonly known as California fuchsia, is a perennial plant species within the four o'clock family (Nyctaginaceae). It is valued for its vibrant magenta flowers, which attract hummingbirds, and its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Mirabilis californica var. glutinosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-pruritic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
